newsitem.title: FRANCE: CSFB reiterates Canal Plus strong buy.
newsitem.headline: CSFB reiterates Canal Plus strong buy.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston media analyst Chris Renaud said in a research note that he was reiterating his "strong buy" of Canal Plus after it reported subscription figures for its Canalsatellite unit.
Renaud said he had a price target of 1,500 francs. Canal Plus traded 4.04 percent higher at 1,186 francs at 1009 GMT.

"A lot of noise and complication surrounds the Canal Plus story. Yet at the end of the day, this stock comes down to the fundamental number of subscribers the company has and the free cash flow each of those subscribers generates," he said.
"Subscriber growth remains strong in the first few weeks of the year for Canal Plus, particularly in France and Italy," he said.

French pay-television group Canal Plus said on Thursday its overall subscriber base rose 13 percent in 1996 to 8.21 million and that it had 220,000 subscribers to its digital service at the end of 1996 which it said was "better than expected".
